Subject: Re: LDAP smtpd_sender_login_maps @domain owner


--- Victor Duchovni
 wrote:
>     http://www.postfix.org/ldap_table.5.html
> 
> Create a list of one or more tables that given a
> user's email address
> will output the user's SASL login name using:
> 
> 	postmap -q ervv@example.com type1:table1
> type2:table2 ...
> 
> with one or more of the tables being "ldap:" tables.
> Make it as simple
> as possible given your schema and the features
> explained in ldap_table(5).
> 
> The approach my employer takes is that the directory
> is extended as
> necessary to match application needs. The mail
> routing schema has evolved
> as our needs have changed.

Found a patch for smtpd_check.c that seems to fix a
bug for the @domain owner search in
smtpd_sender_login_maps.

http://www.irbs.net/internet/postfix/0208/0889.html

We want to be able to let our users send/recieve mail
for external, forwarding domains (i.e., gmail.com). 
The smtpd_sender_login_maps is just too tedious and
aggressive for our environment.

We need to find a simpler solution.

Kind Regards,


Gary
